If anyone wants to pay in two lots that is fine, £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January. As long as I have it all by 31 January.

Jan: 7th to 14th August.

Pete and Linda: May half term, 29th May to 5th June.

Me and Bev: 5th to 12th June, so we can hand over on the 5th.

Carol: Easter week and a week in September. Let me know which week in September you would like.

Please can everyone make sure the water is turned off at the stop tap when you leave. The park has moaned again about it.

Also, so nobody is surprised, the park says caravans over 15 years old will need a condition survey before the 2028 season. The van is 16 year old now. I will let you know when I hear any more about it.

Any problems let me know.

Regards
Mick
